description: Paired Task Mode versus Company Mode outcome suite for software, content, and research work. Synthetic inputs are safe to run, but only completed governed runs with independent evidence can support promotion.

cases.title: Repair an atomic reservation race
cases.prompt: Diagnose and repair a concurrent reservation race in a small SQLite-backed service. Preserve failed-call accounting, add multiprocess regression coverage, and produce a concise operator note.

goal.title: Repair an atomic reservation race
goal.objective: Produce a verified race-free reservation implementation and evidence.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concurrent workers cannot exceed the declared limit.
Failures remain conservatively accounted and expire by policy.
A repeatable multiprocess test and commands are supplied.

cases.title: Add a governed API feature
cases.prompt: Add a versioned JSON API endpoint to an existing service, including validation, authorization boundaries, backwards compatibility, tests, and migration notes.

goal.title: Add a governed API feature
goal.objective: Ship a backwards-compatible endpoint with enforceable contracts.

acceptance_criteria.description: The API rejects malformed and unauthorized requests.
Existing clients and tests remain compatible.
Usage and migration behavior are documented.

cases.title: Make a private dependency release reproducible
cases.prompt: Replace mutable sibling dependency checkouts with an immutable release manifest, exact source refs, installed-version checks, and clean-wheel verification.

goal.title: Make dependency release reproducible
goal.objective: Ensure CI and local release checks consume the same immutable dependency sources.

acceptance_criteria.description: All dependency refs are full immutable commits.
Source HEAD, package version, and public API are verified.
Drift fails closed with an actionable message.

cases.title: Recover a failed durable delivery
cases.prompt: Investigate a dead-letter delivery after a process crash, prove the external side effect is not duplicated, replay it safely, and document the recovery decision.

goal.title: Recover failed durable delivery
goal.objective: Restore delivery without repeating an external side effect.

acceptance_criteria.description: The side effect occurs at most once.
Replay reason and operator identity are durable.
The message reaches a terminal delivered state.

cases.title: Plan a vertical microdrama episode
cases.prompt: Create a production-ready 60–90 second vertical microdrama package with a hook, beat sheet, scene board, character continuity constraints, and platform-safe ending.

goal.title: Plan a vertical microdrama episode
goal.objective: Deliver a coherent and shootable short-form episode package.

acceptance_criteria.description: The opening establishes conflict within the first beat.
Shots, duration, and transitions are production feasible.
Character, prop, and location anchors are explicit.

cases.title: Build a launch campaign package
cases.prompt: Produce a coherent product launch package: positioning, landing-page outline, three channel variants, CTA hypotheses, and a measurable experiment plan without inventing customer evidence.

goal.title: Build a launch campaign package
goal.objective: Deliver channel-ready campaign assets tied to testable hypotheses.

acceptance_criteria.description: All assets use one defensible positioning.
Claims distinguish facts, assumptions, and hypotheses.
Experiments define audience, metric, and decision rule.

cases.title: Gate character and prop continuity
cases.prompt: Review a synthetic two-scene asset manifest for character identity, costume, prop, composition, and story continuity. Separate object-grounding evidence from judgments requiring stronger VLM or human review.

goal.title: Gate character and prop continuity
goal.objective: Produce scoped, grounded QA decisions without overstating detector evidence.

acceptance_criteria.description: Object evidence is not used to prove identity or aesthetics.
Findings retain artifact, class, confidence, and location evidence.
Unresolved axes enter a human or stronger-VLM review queue.

cases.title: Prepare a platform release package
cases.prompt: Package approved synthetic media metadata for a vertical-video release with rights, aspect, duration, captions, thumbnails, checksum, and delivery manifest gates.

goal.title: Prepare platform release package
goal.objective: Create a traceable, policy-compliant delivery package.

acceptance_criteria.description: Format, aspect, duration, and caption checks pass.
Rights and consent state are explicit and non-placeholder.
Every delivered artifact has source and checksum evidence.

cases.title: Draft an evidence-bound investment memo
cases.prompt: Using only a supplied synthetic source pack, write an investment memo that separates evidence, inference, and unknowns; includes counterarguments; and maps every material claim to a source.

goal.title: Draft evidence-bound investment memo
goal.objective: Deliver a decision-useful memo with complete claim provenance.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every material factual claim maps to supplied evidence.
Inference and unknowns are clearly labeled.
Recommendation includes counterarguments and falsifiers.

cases.title: Build a sourced market map
cases.prompt: Normalize a synthetic company dataset into a market taxonomy, explain inclusion rules, flag conflicting records, and produce a ranked review queue instead of silently resolving ambiguity.

goal.title: Build sourced market map
goal.objective: Create a reproducible taxonomy and reviewable normalized dataset.

acceptance_criteria.description: Categories have explicit inclusion and exclusion rules.
Normalized rows retain source identifiers.
Conflicts and missing values are queued, not invented.

cases.title: Run a due-diligence risk review
cases.prompt: Review a synthetic diligence room, construct a risk register with severity and evidence strength, identify missing documents, and avoid legal or financial conclusions unsupported by the pack.

goal.title: Run due-diligence risk review
goal.objective: Deliver a prioritized, evidence-scoped diligence risk register.

acceptance_criteria.description: Risks include severity, likelihood, evidence, and owner.
Unsupported conclusions are labeled for specialist review.
Missing and conflicting documents are explicit.

cases.title: Produce an executive evidence brief
cases.prompt: Transform a synthetic mixed-quality research pack into a one-page executive brief, a detailed appendix, and a source-quality table. Preserve disagreements and prioritize decisions.

goal.title: Produce executive evidence brief
goal.objective: Deliver concise decisions without losing source quality or disagreement.

acceptance_criteria.description: The brief leads with decisions and material uncertainty.
The summary does not erase source disagreements.
Details and claims link to the appendix and sources.
